note: Set B covers the wiring schedule more completely: it captures the main conductor configurations for the rows (3#6 for 50, 6#10 for 33/34, 2#10 for 31, 3#4/0 for 150/151) and includes symbol 31, all of which Set A omits. Set A is clean and every claim is correctly bound, but it never states the phase conductor size/count for any row and skips rows 31, 20 and 10 entirely. B's weaknesses are redundancy (the same conductor facts repeated under 'conductor' and 'conductor configuration' for 151, 33, 34) and one imprecise binding, calling 32's '2#10USE-2' a conductor configuration when USE-2 is the cable type. Both sets read the values, units and the AL/ARMORED CABLE conditions on 151 correctly.
remarks: Both sets omit schedule rows 20 (CU: 3#12, #12G., 3/4"C.) and 10 (CU: #12/2WG.). B's 'conductor configuration' attribute is inconsistently scoped (sometimes includes the ground conductor, e.g. '6#10, 3#10G.', sometimes only the phase conductors, e.g. '6#10'), producing near-duplicate claims; entity naming also alternates between 'Wiring Symbol n' and 'Symbol n' for the same row.
